heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
17A.35  Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
text: If an opposition is dismissed under regulation 17A.34B or discontinued, the Registrar must notify the parties of the dismissal or discontinuance.
title: Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
